description: STT fixtures with known transcripts, and the texts TTS cells speak. Paths are repo-relative. maxWer is the word error rate a cell must stay at or under.

utterances.name: recording
utterances.transcript: If you can read this, transcription is working.
utterances.source: A human recording (AAC, 48 kHz, 5 s), the executor's transcription e2e fixture.

utterances.name: meeting
utterances.transcript: Please move the weekly planning meeting to Thursday afternoon and invite the design team.
utterances.source: Generated with Kokoro-82M (voice am_michael) through speaches, resampled to 16 kHz mono. The TTS cells use another voice.

utterances.name: weather
utterances.transcript: The forecast says light rain in the morning, clearing to sunshine by the evening.
utterances.source: Generated with Kokoro-82M (voice bf_emma) through speaches, resampled to 16 kHz mono. The TTS cells use another voice.

utterances.name: weather-noisy
utterances.transcript: The forecast says light rain in the morning, clearing to sunshine by the evening.
utterances.source: The weather clip with seeded white noise 5 dB above the clip's RMS level, added at load time. Clean clips do not separate the models (all score 0); this one does.

ttsTexts.text: The library opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
Remember to water the tomato plants before you leave for the airport.
